name: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
summary: Hung Hom university strong in design, hotel and tourism, health and engineering; the middle half of 2026 IB entrants had 33 to 38 points.

ib.text: Successful applicants typically reach 32 or more of 45; a predicted 30 or more may earn an interview. IB English or English Literature at grade 4 (HL or SL). Preferred subjects are listed per scheme.

dates.label: Later applications considered on a rolling basis while places last, until

programmes.name: Hotel and Tourism Management
programmes.about: One scheme with a shared first year, then a choice of Hotel Management, Smart Tourism and Hospitality, or Event and Experience Management, with optional AI and data or innovation secondary majors and a 2+2 option in Vienna or Paris.
programmes.ib: Languages are the preferred subjects; IB English at grade 4. The school may interview, and allocates options after year one on your choice, GPA and interview.
programmes.selectionNote: Middle half of 2026 entrants university-wide held 33 to 38 IB points. The school grants entry scholarships to non-local applicants.

flagshipSource.title: School of Hotel and Tourism Management: teaching hotel and resource centre on campus (school page)

programmes.name: Design
programmes.about: A four-year design scheme: a common foundation year, a cluster year in communication, immersive media and games, environment, product experience or service design, then one of nine specialisms, with exchange, study trips and internships.
programmes.ib: A portfolio is required and applications without one are not considered; shortlisted applicants are interviewed with their portfolio. No preferred IB subjects are listed.
programmes.selectionNote: Submit the portfolio by the application deadline; interviews run from November to April. Middle half of 2026 entrants held 33 to 38 IB points.

flagshipSource.title: BA (Hons) Scheme in Design: nine design specialisms with exchange, study trips and internships (programme page)

programmes.name: Optometry
programmes.about: Five years of general education and basic science, then optometric clinical techniques and five semesters of supervised clinical training with real patients, plus a final project in years four and five.
programmes.ib: A 500-word essay on why you chose optometry is required; no preferred IB subjects are listed. You need the manual dexterity for an eye examination.
programmes.selectionNote: Middle half of 2026 entrants university-wide held 33 to 38 IB points. Only one programme choice is considered for international applicants.

flagshipSource.title: BSc (Hons) in Optometry: five semesters of supervised clinical training with real patients (programme page)

faculties.name: Business
faculties.line: BBA schemes in accounting, finance, logistics, management and marketing; no preferred IB subjects are listed.

faculties.name: Construction and Environment
faculties.line: Physics preferred for building sciences; Physics, Chemistry and Maths for civil engineering.

faculties.name: Computer and Mathematical Sciences
faculties.line: English and Maths preferred for applied maths and finance analytics; the computing and AI schemes list no preferred subjects.

faculties.name: Engineering
faculties.line: Maths, Physics and other STEM subjects preferred, varying by scheme; Maths for Internet-of-Things and information engineering.

faculties.name: Humanities
faculties.line: Chinese History, English and Applied Linguistics, Speech Therapy and Language Science; no preferred IB subjects are listed.

faculties.name: Health and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Biology, Chemistry or Physics preferred for medical lab, radiography and therapy degrees; social work and nursing list none.

faculties.name: Science
faculties.line: Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Maths preferred, depending on the degree.

faculties.name: Design
faculties.line: A portfolio is required and shortlisted applicants are interviewed with it.

faculties.name: Fashion and Textiles
faculties.line: Art, science or business subjects all count as preferred for the Fashion scheme.

faculties.name: Hotel and Tourism Management
faculties.line: Languages are preferred; options are allocated after year one on your choice, GPA and interview.

faculties.name: Interdisciplinary Studies
faculties.line: A bachelor's degree scheme across disciplines; no preferred IB subjects are listed.

notes: Hong Kong sets no EU rate: non-local tuition is HK$240,000 for 2027/28, payable in two instalments, plus an initial fee of HK$20,000 when you accept an offer.
Applicants without a first-round decision are considered in later rounds in competition with others, and applications after the main round are still read on a rolling basis while places last.
Good IB results can earn up to 25% credit transfer on admission to the four-year curriculum.
